settings.fallback_reason: InstanSeg pilot produced many non-nuclear cell fragments; Cellpose-SAM cell boundaries were visually more coherent. InstanSeg retained for independent nuclear QC predictions.
settings.preprocessing: Raw DAPI/Tubulin/Actin retained. DINO: Actin/Tubulin/DAPI RGB scaled by field 1st/99.5th percentiles, isolate mask, aspect-preserving zero padding to 224, ImageNet normalization.

config.selection: First stable image identifier per well; independent of image appearance
config.inference: Pretrained Cellpose-SAM cells after inadequate InstanSeg pilot; pretrained InstanSeg nuclei for QC; generic DINO ImageNet cell-crop embeddings
config.statistics: Descriptive per-well/field summaries only; cells are not independent biological replicates
